messages:
sara_cs: Kicking off Dedicated capacity bring-up for AcmeCorp tomorrow morning. Need to confirm quota sizing, autoscale policy, and load test plan before handoff. Renewal risk if we miss perf SLOs :warning:

devon_platform: Quick ask — what's the expected traffic profile? avg QPS, peak concurrency, token distribution, and models?

sara_cs: Primary is chat (rdl-13b-quant, 8k ctx). Baseline ~45 req/s, peak 180 req/s during EU business hours. Typical response ~150 tokens. They want headroom to burst to ~250 req/s for marketing promos first 30 days. EU data residency required.

mike_infra: For rdl-13b-quant, our ops suggestion: 4x A10 GPUs (or 2x A100 if AZ inventory allows). Start with shard_count=4, allow +2 shards for scale. Recommend prewarming common KV prefixes and enabling persistent warmup.

anita_sre: Load test plan outline: step-ramp to 200 rps sustained 30m, then 5m burst to 300 rps, capture p50/p95/p99 latency and token cost. Observe cold-starts on ramp-down. Also capture model quality samples.

anita_sre: k6 scenario I'll run in staging: 
```
export const options = {
  stages: [
    { duration: '5m', target: 50 },
    { duration: '10m', target: 200 },
    { duration: '30m', target: 200 },
    { duration: '5m', target: 300 },
    { duration: '10m', target: 0 },
  ],
};
```

devon_platform: Proposed autoscale policy to commit to infra repo: 
```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 8
scale_metric: rps_per_replica
target: 40
cooldown: 60s
```
This keeps steady latency and allows headroom for the 250rps bursts.

jonathan_se: I'll own customer enablement — creating runbook + troubleshooting playbook and a 1-pager for Acme ops. Need: who owns peering/VPC, contact for billing/reserved start, and confirmation of EU residency on record.

sara_cs: Peering contact: tina@acme.com. Billing/reserved capacity start date — please ask sales to confirm. EU residency is in contract. Sales contact: chloe_sales.

mike_infra: Adding quota buffer: provision 1.2x peak for first 30 days (i.e., configure for 216 rps baseline capacity, ability to reach 300 rps). I'll open infra ticket to bump pool and prewarm.

deploy-bot: reserved-capacity provisioned: pool-id pc-9f4a, GPUs: 4 x A10, created by mike_infra at 1712101800

devon_platform: Risk playbook: If p95 latency > 400ms for any 48h window, mark renewal_risk and auto-route read-heavy endpoints to rdl-7b fallback. We should also trigger CS_urgent and SRE paging.

sara_cs: Noted — I'll add to renewal risk tracker and wire up automated alerts to CS playbook.

anita_sre: Also: capture 500 recorded prompts from Acme's prod-sandbox to run through the model during load test and run eval labeling (label: acme-q1) to detect regressions. We'll snapshot outputs and compare against baseline.

jonathan_se: Scheduling enablement session with Acme ops: Thursday 10:00 CET. I'll send invite and attach runbook draft. Planning a 30m handover + 30m deep-dive with their security/infra.

sara_cs: Action items (summarized):
- mike_infra: adjust pool + prewarm (ETA today EOD)
- devon_platform: publish autoscale config in infra repo (PR)
- anita_sre: run load tests Thu morning, upload results + eval tags to console
- jonathan_se: finalize runbook + send enablement invite
- sara_cs: follow up with sales on billing start date

mike_infra: On it. :thumbsup:

devon_platform: PR queued, will link in this thread when ready. :eyes:

anita_sre: Starting k6 in ~30m against their staging endpoint, will paste results here.

sara_cs: If anything looks off we pause handoff and do a canary using traffic mirroring. Keep me posted.

jonathan_se: Added Acme participants to the invite: Tina (ops), Marco (sec). Will share peering steps once Tina confirms CIDR ranges.

sales_rep: Confirmed billing start is 2024-04-05 per contract. Reserved capacity invoiced monthly.

sara_cs: Great — thanks all. I'll update the account health dashboard and set renewal_risk threshold monitors.

(END)
